name: Braintrust
description: Eval-first AI observability platform with an open-source autoevals library.
descriptionZh: 以评测为先的 AI 可观测平台，附开源 autoevals 库。
keyFact: Braintrust is an eval-first AI observability platform whose own storage engine Brainstore is proprietary and written in Rust; its open-source autoevals library is MIT-licensed, and the company raised an $80M Series B in February 2026 at a reported ~$800M valuation.
keyFactZh: Braintrust 是以评测为先的 AI 可观测平台，其自研存储引擎 Brainstore 为专有（Rust 编写）；开源的 autoevals 库采用 MIT 许可，公司于 2026 年 2 月完成 8000 万美元 B 轮融资，估值据报约 8 亿美元。
caveat: Self-hosting availability is unclear: sources conflict on whether it is a general option or enterprise-only.
caveatZh: 自托管能力不明确：来源对它是通用选项还是仅企业版存在冲突。
